name: Issachar The Tribe Of
overview: The tribe of Issachar is depicted in Scripture as a significant and organized group within Israel, exemplified by Nethaneel, their prince, who brought a substantial and detailed offering during the dedication, including silver, gold, and various animals for burnt, sin, and peace offerings as recorded in Numbers 7:18-23. This presentation highlights their role in worship and their commitment to the sanctuary. The detailed enumeration of their offerings reflects their standing and responsibility among the tribes of Israel.
